x: Walker set off on the last stage, in the company of Sale and Milner, to gain third place, but was well below his best and not only did he have to give way to his two opponents but Chelmsford (Hill - Cottingham) and Ponders End (McIntyre) rubbed it in by passing him in the last half-mile.

This is always a high-class field and when runners like Cooke (Portsmouth), O'Sullivan (Oxford ),Franklin (Tipton), Hill-Cottingham (Chelms) and Snowden (Surrey) all finish in the thirties, it is decidedly tough.
Charlie Walker had a good run to give us the lead, 3 seconds ahead of Chelmsford (Hill-Cottingham) and Jack Brown increased this to 14secs with Poly (Proffitt) moving up to second place.
